2607.17657.title: OrientSAM: Mitigating Camera-Centric Shortcut in Multimodal Spatial Reasoning via Orientation-Aware Spatial Alignment
2607.17657.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle with spatial reasoning that requires perspective transformation. In particular, they often rely on camera-centric cues rather than reasoning from the reference object's viewpoint, leading to systematic errors in non-camera reference settings. In this paper, we first analyze this failure mode and show that object orientation is a key factor underlying such camera-centric shortcut behavior. To address this issue, we propose OrientSAM, an orientation-aware spatial alignment framework for multimodal models. OrientSAM injects explicit orientation information into multimodal representations through orientation-aware tokens and Fourier-based angle encoding, and further adopts a curriculum learning strategy to progressively improve perspective-aware reasoning. In addition, we build a spatial data construction pipeline to generate orientation-aware spatial supervision from large-scale images. Experiments on Spatial-MM, ViewSpatial, and 3DSRBench show that OrientSAM consistently outperforms strong baselines, especially on non-camera-view, person-centric, and orientation-sensitive tasks. The results further demonstrate that explicit orientation modeling is important for mitigating camera-centric shortcut behavior and enabling more robust allocentric spatial reasoning in multimodal models.
2607.17657.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型 (MLLMs) 在需要視角轉換的空間推理方面仍然存在困難。特別是，它們經常依賴於以相機為中心的線索，而不是從參考物體的視角進行推理，這導致在非相機參考設置中出現系統性錯誤。在本文中，我們首先分析了這種失敗模式，並表明物體方向是導致此類以相機為中心的捷徑行為的關鍵因素。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 OrientSAM，一個針對多模態模型的方向感知空間對齊框架。OrientSAM 通過方向感知標記和基於傅里葉的角度編碼，將明確的方向信息注入多模態表示中，並進一步採用課程學習策略以逐步改善對視角的推理。此外，我們建立了一個空間數據構建管道，以從大規模圖像中生成方向感知的空間監督。在 Spatial-MM、ViewSpatial 和 3DSRBench 上的實驗顯示，OrientSAM 始終優於強基準，特別是在非相機視角、以人為中心和對方向敏感的任務上。結果進一步證明，明確的方向建模對於減輕以相機為中心的捷徑行為和促進多模態模型中更穩健的以物為中心的空間推理是重要的。
